map.毛细上升高度 h = 2×表面张力 γ × cos θ ÷ (密度 ρ × 重力: Capillary rise height h = 2×surface tension γ × cos θ ÷ (density ρ × gravitational acceleration g × tube radius r), with contact angle θ first converted from degrees ×π÷180 to radians, and the result ×1000 shown in mm. Validation: γ, θ, ρ, r and g are guarded as non-empty valid numbers. Criteria: a larger γ or a smaller tube radius raises the rise, and when θ >90° (non-wetting) cos θ is negative and the liquid level falls instead.
